feishu-diagram-chooser 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Enables natural language to structured diagram scheme recommendations.
- Supports Mermaid diagrams (flowchart, sequence, state, ER, class, Gantt, mindmap, timeline), ECharts data chart templates, and image prompts as fallback.
- Outlines clear trigger rules and intent classification for when and how to use the skill.
- Outputs a structured DiagramScheme with primary/alternative recommendations, reasoning, and confidence scoring.
- Handles environment constraints (e.g., Mermaid version, ECharts support) and asks for clarification when intent is ambiguous.
